title: Clinical Reference Laboratory Testing Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY (DHA).DHA ENTERPRISE MED SUPPORT EMS-CD
description_text: The Government is issuing this DRAFT Request for Proposal (RFP), Solicitation Number HT001526RE001, for Clinical Reference Laboratory Testing Services. Please note the following key information regarding this draft release: Anticipated Changes: The Government does not anticipate any major modifications to this Draft RFP or its associated attachments prior to final release. Questions: Questions will not be accepted in response to this Draft Solicitation. Instructions for submitting questions will be provided upon the release of the final solicitation. Final Solicitation: The Final Solicitation is scheduled to be issued within the next seven (7) days.
